shown.message:
Candidate 2 (#14) is merged into `main` at 56854b0, so version 2 of the paper now sits in the open #10 (`main` into `release`) awaiting `internal-review-repo`. `experiment-repo` and `figtab-repo` had both approved it. I rewrote the #10 title and description for version 2. I also commented on #12, answering the review points and asking for a re-review.

The reply names the review items M1, M2, M4, M5 and M7 as answered. M3, the paper-number map in REPRODUCE.md, is with `experiment-repo` and `figtab-repo`.

**GNN and cluster Horvitz–Thompson baselines (M6):** they aren't in this version. `experiment-repo` is still running them. The review wanted them before the final version, so I asked `internal-review-repo` to judge version 2 without them. They go in the appendix when delivered, and the "not run" sentences change then.

**Page fit:** `venue-repo` measured the Conclusion ending on page 9 at de1a3fd. The two later edits swap words only, and I haven't re-checked the system build myself.
